scope: Reviewed production provider write sites that remain on legacy persistence until provider cutover. Coursera, YouTube, LinkedIn, and newspaper start/process now write through the workflow kernel.

versionNotes.1: Baseline established during v0.2.3 architecture foundation (commit f182e8f).
versionNotes.2: Added two direct SQL write primitives in newspaper job_service.rs for the bulk pause/resume introduced with the Pause all / Resume all Download-now morph. Same shape as the existing per-job set_pause contract; will be migrated alongside the rest of the newspaper job_service.rs surface during the newspaper cutover phase.
versionNotes.3: Added three new shared write helpers (clear_linkedin_provider_data, clear_coursera_provider_data, clear_newspaper_provider_data) and recorded one call site per provider. The provider reset path goes through app::cache helpers, keeping the provider's direct SQL surface flat; only the LinkedIn commands.rs file enters the sharedWriteHelperCallCounts map for the first time, because all of its write paths were previously either helpers or per-row UPDATEs that the gate does not track.
versionNotes.4: Moved atomic schedule deletion and owned-work cancellation behind the shared app database boundary, reducing the schedule service direct SQL baseline by one and pinning the new helper call site. Added one reviewed storage migration write for the schedule ownership index.
versionNotes.5: Added the approved Newspaper Clippings Phase 1 repository SQL primitives, DatabaseWriter service/recovery submissions, and provider schema installation. Clipping mutations remain owned by DatabaseWriter; image and filesystem work stays outside writer closures.
versionNotes.6: Moved the media protocol's integrity mutation behind the clipping service, reducing protocol SQL primitives to zero and recording the coalesced service DatabaseWriter submission plus cleanup-cursor setting write in their service, recovery, and repository owners. No filesystem or image work enters a writer closure.
versionNotes.7: Removed the draft filename-cursor setting write after D-031 approved detached complete managed-directory enumeration with per-category mutation caps. This reduces the recovery DatabaseWriter submission count and repository SQL primitive count by one each; no enforcement rule is weakened.
versionNotes.8: Added the reviewed schema-v4 clipping root table, legacy-root seed, populated-v3 table rebuild, one root-registry repository insert, and its one DatabaseWriter submission. The root row commits before crop staging; filesystem and marker work remain outside writer closures.
versionNotes.9: Added the reviewed schema-v5 raw and normalized derived search indexes, atomic repository synchronization/repair savepoints, and the conditional snapshot-root reconnect update. Canonical clipping writes and root locator mutation remain serialized through DatabaseWriter; search reads and filesystem probes do not mutate SQLite.
versionNotes.10: Corrected production-source scanning so internal cfg(test) fields and helpers do not hide later production code. Pinned the already-existing LinkedIn command helper calls and newspaper optimization service SQL writes that were previously omitted by the scanner; no new write site was introduced.
versionNotes.11: Added the reviewed schema-v6 clipping recovery repository writes and one canonical note savepoint seam. Recovery CRUD and matching checkpoint clear remain serialized through the existing DatabaseWriter; draft bytes never enter canonical search owners.
versionNotes.12: Recorded Generic Video / YouTube job-table writes (insert, status update, restart reconcile) and the command-site insert_job helper. Also recorded three Coursera restart-reconcile SQL primitives (transaction plus Failed status and restart_failed event). Both remain on the frozen legacy write path until workflow-kernel cutover; no additional scheduler was added.
versionNotes.13: Coursera start, retry, and process commands now persist through workflow_runs only. Production commands.rs has zero direct SQL primitives and no insert_job / append_job_event / retry_failed_job helpers. Legacy coursera_jobs remain a read/reset/reconcile compatibility projection; job.rs write counts are unchanged.
versionNotes.14: YouTube queue/process commands now persist through workflow_runs only. Production youtube/commands.rs has zero insert_job helpers; youtube/job.rs remains a legacy read/reconcile projection.
versionNotes.15: LinkedIn start, retry, process, and reset now persist through workflow_runs. Production commands.rs no longer calls insert_job or retry_failed_job; the executor materializes a jobs row at execute time for artifact parent keys. Legacy jobs remain a read/cleanup projection.
versionNotes.16: Newspaper batch create, schedule materialize, process, and reset now persist through workflow_runs. Production create() does not insert newspaper_jobs; the executor materializes a newspaper_jobs row at execute time for page/library parent keys. create_with_connection remains the test fixture path. Legacy newspaper_jobs remain a read/progress projection that wins on merge.
versionNotes.17: YouTube V1 now submits durable youtube_download runs and publishes verified media plus raw VTT and normalized transcript JSON. The legacy youtube_jobs write surface is gone; helper launches go through app::managed_process.
